# ataila_ai_gateway_usage (Data Source)

Every tenant's AI gateway usage for a month, heaviest first, each rated at its own rate, and the unattributed bucket (keys no tenant could be found for, priced at the list rate for information and billed to nobody). Needs a token holding `ai-gateway-read-global` or `orders-read-global` (or an admin key) and platform release 1.0.236 or later.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ataila_ai_gateway_usage" "this_month" {}

output "eur_by_tenant" {
  value = { for t in data.ataila_ai_gateway_usage.this_month.tenants : t.tenant_name => t.rated_eur }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `month` (String) The month, `YYYY-MM`, in the platform's billing time zone. Leave it out for the current month (the attribute then reads which month that was).

### Read-Only

- `rate_basis` (String) `list` when every tenant's tiers were priced, `none` when some were not, `pending` when the rates could not be read.
- `rated_complete` (Boolean) Every token was priced; false when a tier had no rate (a floor).
- `rated_eur` (Number) EUR of the tenants (the unattributed bucket is not billed); null when not priced.
- `tenants` (Attributes List) Per tenant, heaviest first. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tenants))
- `totals` (Attributes) The platform's counts, every key included. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--totals))
- `tz` (String) The billing time zone.
- `unattributed` (Attributes) Keys no tenant could be found for; null when every key was attributed. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--unattributed))
- `unrated_tiers` (List of String) Tiers some tenant used without a rate.

<a id="nestedatt--tenants"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tenants`

Read-Only:

- `attribution` (Map of String) Usage rows per attribution method (`registry`, `map`, `project`, `unattributed`); the counts as strings.
- `cache_hits` (Number) Calls answered from the gateway's cache.
- `calls` (Number) Calls.
- `completion_tokens` (Number) Output tokens.
- `customer_id` (String) The tenant's customer.
- `customer_name` (String) The customer's name.
- `failures` (Number) Calls that failed (refused or errored).
- `key_aliases` (List of String) Their aliases.
- `keys` (Number) Keys with usage this month.
- `last_seen` (String) The last call in the month. RFC 3339 in UTC.
- `prompt_tokens` (Number) Input tokens.
- `rate_bases` (List of String) Every basis that priced something.
- `rate_basis` (String) Which rate priced it: `plan` (the tenant's own rate), `list` (the rate card), `contract_included` (an active contract includes metered AI: 0 EUR), `none` (no rate: not priced) or `pending` (the rates could not be read just now; usage is still shown).
- `rated_complete` (Boolean) Every token was priced; false when a tier had no rate (a floor).
- `rated_eur` (Number) EUR at the tenant's rate on each day; null when nothing could be priced. When `rated_complete` is false it is a floor: the tiers without a rate add nothing. The unattributed bucket is priced at the list rate, for information: it is billed to nobody.
- `shadow_usd` (Number) The AI gateway's own price in USD (its shadow price, used for budget enforcement on the gateway). Not the bill: the bill is `rated_eur`.
- `tenant_id` (String) The tenant; null for the unattributed bucket (keys no tenant could be found for).
- `tenant_name` (String) The tenant's display name.
- `tenant_slug` (String) The tenant's slug.
- `total_tokens` (Number) Input and output tokens together.
- `unrated_tiers` (List of String) Tiers without a rate.
